scope.chemistry: Class 9/10 Chemistry entries retained for completeness; deferred outside these two apps.
scope.inventoryUnit: One row per official numbered item. Compound objectives remain components; OR alternatives are labelled. Accessible alternatives and suggested projects are not extra mandatory experiments.
scope.laterImplementation: This is a source-audit baseline. New work must update evidence, not silently inherit completion.

statusDefinitions.existing-simulation: Source has a parameter/action-driven virtual exercise for the stated core objective. Not a claim of real apparatus practice, browser QA, or school credit.
statusDefinitions.existing-protocol: An authored procedure with relevant objective/observations exists, but the corresponding hands-on apparatus is not implemented. Preview animation is not a simulation.
statusDefinitions.partial: Some relevant behavior/content exists, but one or more prescribed apparatus, specimens, measurements or procedure components are missing.
statusDefinitions.missing: No matching practical implementation or authored protocol identified in the audited apps. Related theory text is not coverage.

evidenceLimitations: Read-only source audit; no new runtime/browser/assistive-technology or hardware validation is claimed.
Status records existing app capability, never student completion. All schoolPracticalCompleted values remain false.
Canonical IDs below are audit IDs. Source selectors and registration IDs identify actual current resources; this JSON does not add routes.
Physics PeqBench.has returns true for every name; its mount returns only stop and draws elapsed-time previews. These previews are not completed interactive apparatus.
Physics SIMS.pendulum is a double pendulum. Separate Research pendulum-g generates synthetic simple-pendulum readings.
Biology microscope uses original illustrated slides, not photomicrographs; no claim of species/clinical accuracy.
Digital rehearsal does not replace supervised school practicals, assessed records, teacher observation or tactile accommodations.
Accessible alternative lists are curriculum scope, not proof of accessible software. Every eventual bench requires keyboard, screen-reader, text-table and reduced-motion checks.

sourceDiscrepancies.detail: Guidelines refer to ten alternative experiments; the Class XII printed list contains eight numbered items. Inventory follows those eight; no items are invented.
General guidelines refer to ten alternatives; the printed Biology lists have eight for XI and seven for XII. Preserve the published lists and ask the teacher for local assessment instructions.

Human pedigree examples in the syllabus include traits often oversimplified as single-gene. Use fictional validated Mendelian traits or an appropriately qualified colour-vision/ABO example; do not teach tongue rolling, earlobes or widow’s peak as universally simple Mendelian.
The year-end assessment note conflicts with preceding heredity/current listings. Practical inventory is independently explicit on pp7–8; teacher confirmation is required for exam-coverage claims.

recordRequirements.subject: Science
recordRequirements.requirement: Practical work accompanies theory. These numbered lists do not turn all app entries into completed school records.

recordRequirements.subject: Physics
recordRequirements.requirement: Maintain at least eight experiments, four from each section; six activities, three from each section; and an investigatory project report.
recordRequirements.appStatus: Digital observations can support preparation, not teacher-signed completion.

recordRequirements.subject: Biology
recordRequirements.requirement: Major/minor experiments, slide preparation, spotting, practical record/viva and project record/viva are distinct assessment components.
recordRequirements.appStatus: No school-assessed practical record or project is complete just because a virtual lesson was viewed.

recordRequirements.subject: Biology
recordRequirements.requirement: Major experiment, minor experiment, slide preparation, spotting, practical record/viva and investigatory project are distinct.
recordRequirements.appStatus: Virtual guides do not certify supervised sampling, slide preparation or project work.

recordRequirements.requirement: Accessible alternative examination: apparatus familiarity, written practical skills, practical record and viva. At least five listed experiments recorded with teacher checking/signature; the stated guidelines include 15 short questions of which 10 are answered.
recordRequirements.appStatus: A screen-reader-friendly app is helpful but cannot itself certify tactile work or examination accommodations.

required: Authentic main/vernier or pitch/circular scale with declared least count
Positive, negative and zero zero-error cases
Correct signed zero correction
Object-dependent jaws/anvil/depth positioning
Multiple observations and mean with units/uncertainty
Deliberate wrong-reading feedback; do not simply display the answer
Keyboard/touch operation and text-readable scales
Reset, preserved student notebook, offline route and regression checks
Distinct aim, apparatus, scientific mechanism and authored method
Operational controls for claimed simulation, otherwise an explicit protocol-only label
Observation table and defensible analysis with units, error/limitations and viva prompts
Prescribed components/OR choices/specimens mapped individually
Official source and academic year visible
No progress credit for roadmap placeholders or unrelated diagrams
Class-specific discovery without destroying existing routes/notes
Verify current source IDs before linking
Never equate PeqBench.has with real controls
Do not map double pendulum to simple-pendulum practical
Do not label a generic fish Rohu without verified anatomical/species evidence
Keep standard mammal blastula and alternative frog development distinct
Do not model complex human traits as simple Mendelian certainties
Synthetic data/sample banner where appropriate
No unsolicited camera request
No unsupervised mains, body-fluid collection, heating, corrosive or scalpel instruction in student workflows
No medical diagnosis from simulated urine/pathogen tests
Keyboard, touch, text alternatives, focus order, screen-reader/table labels and reduced motion
Accessible curriculum alternatives remain separately identified and teacher reviewed
Source synchronization and single-file packaging
App-scoped regression checks and protected-boundary preservation
Fresh/returning/deep-link/offline workflow tests
Responsive practical controls and meaningful input-driven state assertions
Independent diff review, required CI, tested PR merge and live artifact parity
Do not claim all practicals implemented until every mapped requirement has evidence

summary.doNotSumAsMandatory: Accessible alternatives overlap standard tasks, and eight Physics projects are suggestions, not eight compulsory projects. Compound specimens are retained as components, not separate numbered experiments.
